country.name: New Zealand
country.pr: Skilled Work Experience Pathway: skill level 1-3 role, 5 years relevant experience including 2 years in New Zealand at 1.1x the median wage. Trades and Technician Pathway: relevant Level 4+ qualification, 4 years experience including 18 months in NZ at or above the median wage. Applicants generally meet only one wage threshold, the one in force when they started accruing experience.
country.citizenship: About 5 years as a resident (general knowledge, not re-verified). Dual citizenship allowed.
country.pro: Eligibility widened and wage rules simplified in the 2026 reform.
country.con: Small economy and job market; fewer senior finance roles (general knowledge).
